strings.zh: 呐,你听我说！{NEWLINE}我有暴鲤龙了！{SCROLL}那条弱小的鲤鱼王{NEWLINE}在我的精心培育下{CLEAR}终于进化了！
strings.en: Hey, listen to this! I’ve got a{NEWLINE}Gyarados!{SCROLL}That weak little Magikarp finally evolved{NEWLINE}after all my careful raising!

strings.zh: 从前这有个强行推销精灵的{NEWLINE}奇怪大叔。{SCROLL}那个孩子从他那买了{NEWLINE}鲤鱼王后,就一直{CLEAR}很细心地照料着！
strings.en: There used to be a weird old man here{NEWLINE}who pushed Pokémon on people. That boy{CLEAR}bought a Magikarp from him and has{CLEAR}taken really good care of it ever since!
strings.notes: US 0461/1; modernised from US 0461#1 | RV017: omission: 强行推销 (pushy selling) and 细心地照料 (careful care) (settles D-1874)

strings.zh: 前一阵子有个奇怪的大叔{NEWLINE}来尼比市推销鲤鱼王,{CLEAR}说什么鲤鱼王能产黄金。{CLEAR}结果那边的孩子真的就买了一只！{CLEAR}我感觉他是被骗了。
strings.en: A while back, a weird old man came to{NEWLINE}Pewter City selling Magikarp. He claimed{CLEAR}Magikarp could produce gold.{SCROLL}And that kid over there actually bought{NEWLINE}one! I think he got scammed.

strings.zh: 我有鲤鱼王哦,{NEWLINE}它是我的第一只精灵。{CLEAR}我会好好珍惜它的！
strings.en: I have a Magikarp. It’s my very first{NEWLINE}Pokémon. I’m going to take good care of{CLEAR}it!
